check_vasp_electronic_convergence: check if a VASP DFT calculation converged electronically by parsing the OSZICAR file
count_scf_and_ionic_steps: count the total SCF and ionic steps from VASP OSZICAR output files in a directory
review_converged_oszicar_function: review the converged_oszicar function that checks electronic convergence using NELM and EDIFF thresholds
refactor_converged_oszicar_for_custom_pa: refactor the converged_oszicar function to support a custom DFT output parser instead of pymatgen Oszicar
summarize_count_scf_function: summarize the count_scf function that aggregates SCF and ionic step counts across all OSZICAR files
